description: This header file defines the API and constants for managing TR-069 Device.IP.Diagnostics.UploadDiagnostics object, including functions for setting diagnostics state, interface, upload URL, DSCP, Ethernet priority, and test file length. It also includes documentation and comments describing the purpose and usage of each API.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter to indicate diagnostic data status, triggering or monitoring the upload diagnostics process.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Configures the IP-layer interface for the upload diagnostics test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_UploadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL (HTTP or FTP) for uploading diagnostics data.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for marking packets during test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets Ethernet priority code for packets transmitted in the test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_TestFileLength
methods.description: Sets the size in bytes of the file to be uploaded during diagnostics test.
